name: Shrine Icons
description: Art for the Shrine Icons plugin: floating symbols over the shrines that have none in the game (refill, health, mana, portal, gem, fire, monster, exploding, poison) and a minimap icon for each of them. Needs the Shrine Icons D2RLoader plugin. Replaces automap sheets default13 and default07 (cells that no data file uses), with a minimap icon for the booster shrines too.
author: wild-healer

config.name: Symbol size
config.description: Size of the new symbols. 1 matches the booster shrine symbols.

config.name: Symbol height
config.description: How high above the shrine the symbol floats. 14 is the height of the booster shrine symbols.
